workspace_and_public_libraries.name: inspect-isolated-production-dependency-closures
args:
# Successful checks above prove package membership. Inspect forward
# trees: an unknown inverted dependency must not count as evidence.
for flags in '' '--all-features'; do
  cargo tree --locked -p bitrouter-ai $flags -e normal,build --prefix none > ai-tree.txt
  if grep -Eq '^(bitrouter(-sdk)?|reqwest|tokio(-[^ ]*)?|axum|sea-orm(-[^ ]*)?|sqlx(-[^ ]*)?|ratatui(-[^ ]*)?|crossterm|opentelemetry[^ ]*|tracing-opentelemetry|agent-client-protocol[^ ]*|rmcp) v' ai-tree.txt; then
    echo '::error::AI public contracts pulled runtime dependencies'; exit 1
  fi
  cargo tree --locked -p bitrouter-sdk $flags -e normal,build --prefix none > sdk-tree.txt
  if grep -Eq '^(bitrouter|axum|sea-orm(-[^ ]*)?|sqlx(-[^ ]*)?|ratatui(-[^ ]*)?|crossterm|opentelemetry[^ ]*|tracing-opentelemetry|agent-client-protocol[^ ]*|rmcp) v' sdk-tree.txt; then
    echo '::error::HTTP SDK pulled service, execution or UI dependencies'; exit 1
  fi
done
cargo tree --locked -p bitrouter-guardrails --all-features -e normal,build --prefix none > guardrails-tree.txt
if grep -Eq '^(bitrouter(-sdk)?|axum|opentelemetry[^ ]*) v' guardrails-tree.txt; then
  echo '::error::matcher depends on its host implementation'; exit 1
fi
cargo tree --locked -p bitrouter -e normal,build --prefix none > host-tree.txt
if grep -Eq '^bitrouter-guardrails v' host-tree.txt; then
  echo '::error::default bro links the optional matcher'; exit 1
fi

workspace_and_public_libraries.name: public-api
args:
for package in bitrouter-ai bitrouter-sdk; do
  listing="$RUNNER_TEMP/$package-public-api.txt"
  cargo "+nightly-2026-05-05" public-api \
    -p "$package" --all-features --simplified > "$listing"
  # --simplified excludes foreign blanket impls rustdoc attaches to
  # every type. Real authored fields and bounds remain in the listing.
  if [[ "$package" == bitrouter-ai ]]; then
    sentinels=(
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::protocol::chat_completions::ChatRequest'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::gateway::ModelsResponse'
      'pub mod bitrouter_ai::extension'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::control::reload::ReloadInput'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::control::requests::RequestFilters'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::control::status::StatusReport'
      'pub enum bitrouter_ai::control::action::Action'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::control::error::ErrorEnvelope'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::eval::EvalSubject'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::eval::AdmissionOutcome'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::core::evidence::NativeAttemptReport'
      'pub enum bitrouter_ai::core::evidence::NativeTokenCost'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::core::protocol::ClientMessage'
      'pub enum bitrouter_ai::core::protocol::ServerMessage'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::core::protocol::ErrorEnvelope'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::core::checkpoint::CheckpointBatch'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::core::responses::CreateRequest'
      'pub struct bitrouter_ai::core::responses::FunctionOutput'
    )
    forbidden='extension::request_check::Registration|ExtensionApi|NativeExecutionControl|NativePrivateContextRuntime|CommitGate|VerifiedBatch|CheckpointBatchExt|HarnessManifestExt|ClientMessageExt|ToolResultLimitsExt|::capture_cache|::commitment\(|ToolResultOutput::(from_untyped_value|to_provider_string)|DataContent::(to_url|from_url)|Source::synthesize_id|GenerationParams::(extras_for_protocol|extra_value_for_protocol)|Prompt::required_capabilities|ModelTokenLimits::output_reservation_covers_model|NativeRoute::requires_input_count|Limits::within|Capabilities::negotiate|bitrouter::|bitrouter_sdk::|reqwest::|tokio::|axum|sea_orm|sqlx|ratatui|crossterm|opentelemetry|tracing_subscriber|agent_client_protocol|rmcp::'
  else
    sentinels=(
      'pub struct bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient'
      'bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient::chat_completions'
      'bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient::stream_responses'
      'pub struct bitrouter_sdk::control::ControlClient'
      'bitrouter_sdk::control::ControlClient::reload'
      'bitrouter_sdk::control::ControlClient::operation'
      'bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient::submit_eval_result'
      'bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient::eval_snapshot'
      'bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient::core_capabilities'
      'bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient::managed_responses'
      'bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient::stream_managed_responses'
      'bitrouter_sdk::gateway::GatewayClient::core_channel'
      'pub struct bitrouter_sdk::core::CoreChannel'
      'pub struct bitrouter_sdk::core::CoreSender'
      'pub struct bitrouter_sdk::core::CoreReceiver'
    )
    forbidden='bitrouter::|axum|sea_orm|sqlx|ratatui|crossterm|opentelemetry|tracing_subscriber|agent_client_protocol|rmcp::|tokio_tungstenite|tungstenite::'
  fi
  for sentinel in "${sentinels[@]}"; do
    if ! grep -qF "$sentinel" "$listing"; then
      echo "::error::$package public API listing is missing '$sentinel'"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
  if hits="$(grep -niE "$forbidden" "$listing")"; then
    echo "::error::runtime ownership leaked into $package's public API"
    printf '%s\n' "$hits"
    exit 1
  fi
  # A public re-export can hide its foreign origin in the listing.
  # Consumers import each contract from its owning public module.
  if hits="$(grep -rnE '^[[:space:]]*pub use[[:space:]]' "crates/$package/src/")"; then
    echo "::error::$package contains a public forwarding export"
    printf '%s\n' "$hits"
    exit 1
  fi
  crate_name="${package//-/_}"
  grep -oE '\b[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*(::[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)+' "$listing" \
    | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u \
    | grep -vxE "$crate_name|core|std|alloc" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/$package-public-api-deps.txt"
  diff -u \
    <(grep -v '^#' "crates/$package/public-api-deps.txt") \
    "$RUNNER_TEMP/$package-public-api-deps.txt"
done

packaged_gateway.commands:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.99.0 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2
p0_out=/tmp/bitrouter-p0-d233944-packaged
cargo run --locked -p dist-helper -- package --profile gateway --target aarch64-apple-darwin --cargo-profile dev --out "$p0_out"
(
  cd "$p0_out"
  shasum -a 256 -c ./*.sha256
  mkdir unpacked
  tar -xzf bitrouter-gateway-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz -C unpacked
)
cargo build --locked --manifest-path apps/bitrouter/tests/fixtures/sdk_consumer/Cargo.toml --target-dir /tmp/bitrouter-p0-sdk-consumer-target
export BITROUTER_TEST_GATEWAY_BINARY="$p0_out/unpacked/bitrouter-gateway-aarch64-apple-darwin/bro"
export BITROUTER_TEST_SDK_CONSUMER_BINARY=/tmp/bitrouter-p0-sdk-consumer-target/debug/bitrouter-packaged-sdk-consumer
cargo test --locked -p bitrouter --no-default-features --test packaged_gateway packaged_gateway_independent_sdk_consumer -- --ignored --exact --nocapture
for package in bitrouter bitrouter-ai bitrouter-sdk bitrouter-guardrails; do
  cargo package --locked --allow-dirty --list -p "$package" > "$p0_out/$package-files.txt"
done
ruby -rjson -e '
  out=ARGV.fetch(0)
  required={
    "bitrouter"=>%w[Cargo.toml src/lib.rs src/main.rs build.rs build_artifact.rs registry-dist/agents.json registry-dist/runtimes.json registry-dist/providers.json registry-dist/models.json providers/bitrouter.toml policy/default.yaml examples/config_schema.rs examples/legacy_guardrails.rs],
    "bitrouter-ai"=>%w[Cargo.toml README.md src/lib.rs src/core/protocol.rs src/core/checkpoint.rs span-schema.json],
    "bitrouter-sdk"=>%w[Cargo.toml README.md src/lib.rs src/gateway.rs src/control.rs src/harness.rs src/core.rs],
    "bitrouter-guardrails"=>%w[Cargo.toml src/lib.rs]
  }
  required.each do |package,assets|
    listed=File.readlines(File.join(out,"#{package}-files.txt"),chomp:true)
    missing=assets-listed
    abort "Missing #{package} assets: #{missing}" unless missing.empty?
    abort "Generated target files in #{package}" if listed.any?{|p|p.start_with?("target/")}
    puts "PASS #{package} required package assets (#{listed.length} files)"
  end
  File.write(File.join(out,"package-assets.json"),JSON.pretty_generate(required)+"\n")
' "$p0_out"
